instrument.prelaunch_change: Import the Cutlass metadata dependency beside Torch before compiler or GPU work, so a missing dependency cannot orphan another executed result.

environment.preflight: One CPU-only process using exactly these paths imported Torch 2.13.0+cu130, Triton 3.7.1, Cutlass 4.7.0 and cutlass.cute.

acceptance.failure: retain the first second-successor result or pre-record failure; do not retry, change inputs, widen tolerance or rewrite this plan
